title: Accessibility (a11y) Basics
description: Operator panel must be keyboard-navigable and screen-reader friendly. Cyber theatrics ≠ a11y.

rules.message: <div onClick> is not keyboard-accessible — Tab/Enter ignore it.
rules.remediation: Use <button> for actions. Style with className, not by replacing the element.

rules.message: Icon-only <button> without aria-label or title — screen reader announces nothing.
rules.remediation: Add aria-label="verb the object" (e.g. aria-label="Restart server").

rules.message: without alt attribute — fails screen readers.
rules.remediation: Add alt="description". For decorative use alt="" (empty, not missing).

rules.message: <input> without aria-label / placeholder / linked <label> — screen reader has no context.
rules.remediation: Either id + <label htmlFor="...">, or aria-label on the input.
